decisions.rationale: This is a return-leg-only departure-time policy and must remain separate from general departure timing preferences because it can produce a different answer for the outbound leg.
This general policy permits either afternoon or evening departures, so it is not policy-equivalent to an afternoon-only preference.
This is a general afternoon-only departure-time preference; it differs from the broader afternoon-or-evening policy and belongs in departure and arrival timing rather than schedule flexibility.
